AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#rootItem
		REPLACE visible WITH {
			visible: BatteryManager.displayState !== BatteryManager.DeepSleep
				|| Settings.lightSleepEnabled === true
		}
		REPLACE Connections[.target=BatteryManager] WITH {
			Connections {
				target: BatteryManager

				function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
					let isAwake = next === BatteryManager.Normal;
					let wasAwake = previous === BatteryManager.Normal;

					if (isAwake !== wasAwake) {
						var vcOn = false;
						try { vcOn = (Settings.lightSleepEnabled === true); } catch (e) { vcOn = false; }
						if (isAwake || !vcOn) { EPFramebuffer.scheduleGhostRemoval(); }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
